prompt: Tell me something interesting about honey.
output: One fascinating fact about honey is that it is one of the few foods that doesn't require refrigeration and can last for centuries. In fact, some ancient honey still tastes good today! The honey from the 11th century in France, known as the "Honey of the Tower of Paris," has been preserved for over 900 years and is still edible. This is because honey has a very low water content (about 18%) and a high sugar content, which creates an environment that is hostile to bacteria and other microorganisms. This natural preservation makes honey one of the oldest known food sources in human history.
